Utility Macros
Soulstone Mouseover -- Casts Soulstone on your mouseover, conventional [@mouseover,exists] macros got broken a while ago, this is a work around for it.
Unending Breath Selftcast -- Casts Unending Breath on yourself without targeting anything. Useful for situations where you're not able to DPS anything to still fish for trinket proccs / stacks.
Shadowfury / Howl of Terror choice -- Swaps between Shadowfury and Howl of Terror depending on which talent got picked.

/cast [known:Howl of Terror] Howl of Terror

innerBlocks.innerHTML: Cursor Macros
Binding Shot -- Casts Binding Shot on your cursor without confirmation.
Tar Trap - Uses Tar Trap on your cursor position without confirmation.
Mouseover Macros
Barbed Shot -- Casts Barbed Shot on your mouseover or target.
Tranquilizing Shott] -- Casts Tranquilizing Shot on your mouseover target.
Concussive Shot -- Casts Concussive Shot on your mouseover target.
Pet Macros
We're mainly using custom macros for Pets because pets don't cast their own abilities reliably enough and doing it yourself is a DPS gain.
Kill Command pet attack -- Casts Kill Command and your pets basic attack at your target.
Multi-Shot pet attack -- Casts Multi-Shot and your pets basic attack at your target.
Barbed Shot pet attack -- Casts Barbed Shot and your pets basic attack at your target.
Cobra Shot pet attack -- Casts Cobra Shot and your pets basic attack at your target.
Utility Macros
Counter Shot focus -- Casts Counter Shot at your focus target or your current target if your focus target doesn't exist.
Aspect of the Turtle cancelaura -- Casts Aspect of the Turtle and allows you to immediately cancel it upon pressing it again.

#showtooltip
/cast Aspect of the Turtle
/cancelaura Aspect of the Turtle

children.html: [[spell:360995]] -- Casts [[spell:360995]] on your mouseover target.
These macros make [[spell:370665]] easier to use.

Cast on Player [[spell:370665]] Macro -- This macro makes [[spell:370665]] move your friendly target to your location, requiring you to press the macro button and then mouse-click on your unit frames on the chosen target.

Cast on Cursor [[spell:370665]] Macro -- This macro makes [[spell:370665]] move you and your friendly target to your cursor's location, requiring you to first choose the unit, aim with your cursor and then press the macro button.

[[spell:358734]] -- Activates or cancels the Evoker double-jump / slow fall ability [[spell:358734]], I recommend keybinding it to mouse scroll wheel down for easy knockback canceling and mobility usage.

[[spell:360995]], [[spell:361469]] and [[spell:355913]] Self-heal Macros -- It is also possible to use a self-target key modifier but I recommend keybinding these for easy self-healing without needing to target yourself.

innerBlocks.innerHTML: Cursor Macros

Deep Breath -- Allows you to cast Deep Breath with one button press, aimed at your cursor, instead of first aiming it with the ground template and then activating it. When playing Scalecommander you won't need this anymore because of Maneuverability!
Mouseover Macros
Expunge -- Casts Expunge on your mouseover or target.
Cauterizing Flame -- Casts Cauterizing Flame on your mouseover target.
Spatial Paradox / Time Spiral -- Casts Spatial Paradox on your mouseover target or Time Spiral depending on your talent choice.

#showtooltip [known:Spatial Paradox] Spatial Paradox; Time Spiral
/cast [@mouseover, help, nodead, known:Spatial Paradox] Spatial Paradox
/cast [known:Time Spiral] Time Spiral
Verdant Embrace -- Casts Verdant Embrace on your mouseover target.
Rescue Macros
These macros make Rescue easier to use.

Cast on Player Rescue Macro -- This macro makes Rescue move your friendly target to your location, requiring you to press the macro button and then mouse-click on your unit frames on the chosen target.

Cast on Cursor Rescue Macro -- This macro makes Rescue move you and your friendly target to your cursor's location, requiring you to first choose the unit, aim with your cursor and then press the macro button.
Utility Macros
Glide -- Activates or cancels the Evoker double-jump / slow fall ability Glide, I recommend keybinding it to mouse scroll wheel down for easy knockback canceling and mobility usage.

Verdant Embrace, Living Flame and Emerald Blossom Self-heal Macros -- It is also possible to use a self-target key modifier but I recommend keybinding these for easy self-healing without needing to target yourself.

children.html: [[spell:360995]] -- Casts [[spell:360995]] on your mouseover target.
These macros make [[spell:370665]] easier to use.

Cast on Player [[spell:370665]] Macro -- This macro makes [[spell:370665]] move your friendly target to your location, requiring you to press the macro button and then mouse-click on your unit frames on the chosen target.

Cast on Cursor [[spell:370665]] Macro -- This macro makes [[spell:370665]] move you and your friendly target to your cursor's location, requiring you to first choose the unit, aim with your cursor and then press the macro button.

[[spell:358734]] -- Activates or cancels the Evoker double-jump / slow fall ability [[spell:358734]], I recommend keybinding it to mouse scroll wheel down for easy knockback canceling and mobility usage.

[[spell:360995]], [[spell:361469]] and [[spell:355913]] Self-heal Macros -- It is also possible to use a self-target key modifier but I recommend keybinding these for easy self-healing without needing to target yourself.

innerBlocks.innerHTML: Cursor Macros

Deep Breath -- Allows you to cast Deep Breath with one button press, aimed at your cursor, instead of first aiming it with the ground template and then activating it. When playing Scalecommander you won't need this anymore because of Maneuverability!
Mouseover Macros
Expunge -- Casts Expunge on your mouseover or target.
Cauterizing Flame -- Casts Cauterizing Flame on your mouseover target.
Spatial Paradox / Time Spiral -- Casts Spatial Paradox on your mouseover target or Time Spiral depending on your talent choice.

#showtooltip [known:Spatial Paradox] Spatial Paradox; Time Spiral
/cast [@mouseover, help, nodead, known:Spatial Paradox] Spatial Paradox
/cast [known:Time Spiral] Time Spiral
Verdant Embrace -- Casts Verdant Embrace on your mouseover target.
Rescue Macros
These macros make Rescue easier to use.

Cast on Player Rescue Macro -- This macro makes Rescue move your friendly target to your location, requiring you to press the macro button and then mouse-click on your unit frames on the chosen target.

Cast on Cursor Rescue Macro -- This macro makes Rescue move you and your friendly target to your cursor's location, requiring you to first choose the unit, aim with your cursor and then press the macro button.
Utility Macros
Glide -- Activates or cancels the Evoker double-jump / slow fall ability Glide, I recommend keybinding it to mouse scroll wheel down for easy knockback canceling and mobility usage.

Verdant Embrace, Living Flame and Emerald Blossom Self-heal Macros -- It is also possible to use a self-target key modifier but I recommend keybinding these for easy self-healing without needing to target yourself.

[[spell:43265]] - Casts [[spell:43265]] at your cursor position.

If you do not like [[spell:43265]] on your cursor you can replace [@cursor] with [@player] and it will instead put it at your feet. Having either of these is important as it removes the targeting reticle and allows you to get it out faster.
[[spell:77575]] - Casts [[spell:77575]] at your mouseover if it exists or your target.
[[spell:45524]] - Casts ‍[[spell:45524]] at your mouseover if it exists or your target.
[[spell:47528]] - Casts [[spell:47528]] at your mouseover if it exists or your target.
[[spell:49576]] - Casts ‍[[spell:49576]] at your mouseover target if it exists or your target.
[[spell:61999]] - Casts [[spell:61999]] on your mouseover so you can use this on your frames.
Set Focus Mouseover - This will set your focus to your mouseover.
Focus [[spell:49576]] - Casts [[spell:49576]] at your focus.
Focus [[spell:47528]] - Casts [[spell:47528]] at your focus.

While rare, you need some pet spells bound as pets can be very stupid even on assist. This can happen especially on bosses with large hitboxes as they like to follow the bosses back and they can end up being over 100 yards away.
Pet Attack - Sometimes you will want your pet to target specific things and not follow you around.
Pet Follow - Rarely needed, but sometimes you want your ghoul to stop hitting its target.
Pet Move - For the fights you just can not get your ghoul in the right position.
[[spell:47481]] - As you do not want this on auto-cast, this enables you to have a stun which is incredibly powerful on some fights. This also works while your pet is in [[spell:63560]].
[[spell:47482]] / [[spell:91802]] - While this is almost always on auto-cast, you will want this bound for the extremely rare situations that pet kick can be useful.

If you do not like Death and Decay on your cursor you can replace [@cursor] with [@player] and it will instead put it at your feet. Having either of these is important as it removes the targeting reticle and allows you to get it out faster.
Mouseover Macros
Outbreak - Casts Outbreak at your mouseover if it exists or your target.
Chains of Ice - Casts ‍Chains of Ice at your mouseover if it exists or your target.
Mind Freeze - Casts Mind Freeze at your mouseover if it exists or your target.
Death Grip - Casts ‍Death Grip at your mouseover target if it exists or your target.
Raise Ally - Casts Raise Ally on your mouseover so you can use this on your frames.
Focus Macros
Set Focus Mouseover - This will set your focus to your mouseover.
Focus Death Grip - Casts Death Grip at your focus.
Focus Mind Freeze - Casts Mind Freeze at your focus.
Pet Macros

While rare, you need some pet spells bound as pets can be very stupid even on assist. This can happen especially on bosses with large hitboxes as they like to follow the bosses back and they can end up being over 100 yards away.
Pet Attack - Sometimes you will want your pet to target specific things and not follow you around.
Pet Follow - Rarely needed, but sometimes you want your ghoul to stop hitting its target.
Pet Move - For the fights you just can not get your ghoul in the right position.
Gnaw - As you do not want this on auto-cast, this enables you to have a stun which is incredibly powerful on some fights. This also works while your pet is in Dark Transformation.
Leap / Shambling Rush - While this is almost always on auto-cast, you will want this bound for the extremely rare situations that pet kick can be useful.
